editionNotes: Five source stanzas and common refrain; no tempo invented. Verse-dependent tie/syllable relationships retained.
All four source voices and final bass octave,314 heads; source fermatas/ties/slurs retained

All five printed stanzas, refrain, and all four source voice streams retained; final bass octave is a two-note chord. Same Owens/Kirkpatrick hymn as catalog Will Your Anchor Hold - Piano; traditional vocal edition, no recording-arrangement match claimed. Printed ties retained where alternate stanzas split syllables across tied notes; performance articulation is verse-dependent. The source splits the fermata phrase ending and following pickup with separate barlines; those partial bars are retained. Printed stanza 4 reads "On the rising tide it the never fail"; the apparent source typo is retained without silent correction. Two lower-staff slurs in source system 2 have coincident paths; both voice slurs are retained. Recommended copy corrects three verified source-text errors using Winning Songs1892,p165; canonical transcription remains literal.
